items.name: El Al pretzel sandwich with gouda & omelette

items.name: El Al coconut snack

items.name: Maple-Balsamic Mustard Vinaigrette (homemade)
items.recipe: Olive oil, balsamic vinegar, mustard, maple syrup, lemon juice, whisked together.
items.source: Estimated from a typical vinaigrette ratio (oil-dominant, ~3:1 oil:acid, plus a spoon each of mustard/maple). Recurring homemade salad dressing — refine per-ml if a batch is ever measured.

items.source: Manufacturer/product data (agamibakery.co.il, cross-checked via foodsdictionary.co.il, product page itself bot-blocked): ~20g protein/100g, enriched with soy + pea protein, ~70% less carb than white pita, ~10g net/available carb per ~70g pita (implying high fiber). items.name: מגולגלות שוקולד (chocolate rolled cookies, homemade — similar to Keren Agam's Ferrero-filled recipe)
items.recipe: Rolled shortcrust-pastry cookie (butter/margarine, flour, sugar, egg dough) spread with chocolate-hazelnut spread, rolled into a log, sliced and baked — pinwheel/rugelach-style. User's homemade version is 'similar to' the linked recipe, not identical.
items.source: Reference recipe: mako.co.il "מגולגלות שוקולד פררו" by Keren Agam (https://www.mako.co.il/food-weekend/keren_baking_for_sabbath/Recipe-afed6b4e15ade91026.htm) — page bot-blocked (403), so exact ingredient quantities weren't retrievable. Estimated from typical butter-shortcrust + chocolate-hazelnut-spread rolled cookie macros (~430 kcal/100g). Refine if the user's actual recipe/quantities are ever provided.

items.name: Homemade chicken meatballs (veg-loaded)
items.recipe: 1 kg ground chicken; 1 large onion (chopped, fried); grated sweet potato; grated zucchini/courgette; salt, pepper; a little ketchup; 2 eggs; ~½ cup breadcrumbs. Rest ~1h in fridge, spoon onto pan, fry on medium heat.
items.source: Estimated from recipe; ~2,250 kcal total over ~1,275 g cooked yield → ~176 kcal/100 g. Refine if you weigh the cooked batch.

items.name: Milk protein drink, vanilla, no added sugar (משקה חלבון חלב בטעם וניל עם ממתיק)
items.source: Read directly from the product's Hebrew nutrition label, per 100ml: 56 kcal, 0g fat, 44mg sodium, 3.7g carbs (3.7g sugar, 1 sugar-cube equivalent), 10g protein, 294mg calcium.
